title: crater.settings.json
description: How crater installs packages in this project: folder names, aliases and what it may change.

oneOf.description: The folder alone, the alias is its name.

path.description: Folder the packages go into, relative to the project.

alias.description: Name of the .luaurc alias for this folder, so require("@Packages/Promise") works. Empty uses the folder name.

$schema.description: Lets editors show these descriptions. crater ignores it.

client.description: Where import_client packages go, for example { "path": "Packages", "alias": "" }.

server.description: Where import_server packages go, for example { "path": "ServerPackages", "alias": "" }.

develop.description: Where import_develop packages go, for example { "path": "DevPackages", "alias": "" }.

luaurc.description: Which .luaurc gets an alias for every package folder on install, or false to leave .luaurc alone.

vscode_definitions.description: true adds the .d.luau files of installed packages to .vscode/settings.json for luau-lsp.

confirm.description: true asks before every action that changes files. -y skips the question once.

link_style.description: How link files require packages: roblox uses script.Parent paths, string uses require("./name") paths.

darklua.description: When your code requires through aliases like @Packages, install sets up darklua (.darklua.json, build.project.json and a build script) so the code works in Roblox. false turns it off.

import_client_path.description: Old name of client.path, still read.

import_server_path.description: Old name of server.path, still read.

import_develop_path.description: Old name of develop.path, still read.

import_client_alias.description: Old name of client.alias, still read.

import_server_alias.description: Old name of server.alias, still read.

import_develop_alias.description: Old name of develop.alias, still read.

on_install_update_luaurc.description: Old form of luaurc: false, still read.

luaurc_path.description: Old form of luaurc: "path", still read.

on_install_update_vscode_luau_definition.description: Old name of vscode_definitions, still read.

on_install_should_i_ask_your_permission_.description: Old name of confirm, still read.
